response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), s AS (SELECT observstation, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT observstation, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_telescope_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_share_minus_overall_avg FROM a WHERE share > avg_share;

assumptions.assumption: Observatories are those appearing in the telescopes table (grouped by observstation); observatories with zero telescopes are not included in the average share baseline, as the request starts from telescopes records.
Share is computed as real-valued division (count / grand total), with no rounding.
